about_the_game:
A hand-drawn ARPG Roguelike that's also a Tower Defense: level up your character and carry loot between runs, while experimenting with different skills and upgrades as you build towers and hack and slash your way through hordes of monsters marching towards your town.

Game Features

  • Classic isometric art, hand-drawn and traditionally animated.

  • Tight, responsible 2D controls. Light attacks, heavy attacks, aim and charge up projectiles. Dodge or Charge your way through waves of ghouls and monsters.

  • Level up your character, become stronger within each run as well as between runs, allowing you to start stronger each time. Try new skills and try different weapons each run!

  • Keep your favorite weapons each run, give old weapons to your mercenaries or towers to make them even stronger.

  • 10 elemental upgrades, some stronger and weaker against different enemies, but they all have upgradable and unique mechanics. You also don't need to choose, they all stack onto of each other.

  • Collect coins that explode from their bodies as you hit them.

  • A massive cast of enemies and bosses

name: The Universe of Death
short_description: Hand-drawn isometric Diablo style rogue like with Elden Ring style controls, and it's also a tower defense. Level up in run to try new skills and builds, level up between runs to increase your stats to begin each run stronger. Acquire loot and give old loot to your towers and mercenaries.
